pair.title: Pair with your hub
pair.intro: Ask an admin for a pairing code. They make one in Hub management in the web app. A code works once, for 10 minutes.
pair.revoked: This device was removed from the hub. Pair it again to reconnect.
pair.hubUrlHint: The address you open the web app at, for example https://maker.example.com
pair.name: Device name

errors.badUrl: Enter the hub's address, starting with http:// or https://.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach a hub at this address. Check the address and that the hub is running.
errors.invalidCode: The pairing code is wrong, used or expired. Ask an admin for a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
errors.hubOff: This server has the hub turned off. An admin turns it on in Settings → Server.

states.hubOff: The hub is turned off on this server

status.rootsError: Could not send the project roots to the hub: {{error}}
status.manage: Rename or remove this device in Hub management in the web app.
status.updateFailed: The update to version {{version}} did not start, so this connector stays on {{current}}.
status.hubOlder: The hub runs an older version than this connector. Install the connector that matches the hub.

stop.title: Stop the connector?
stop.body: This device goes offline for the hub until the connector starts again: from the Start menu or the launcher, or at your next login.

restarting: Restarting… This page reloads by itself in a few seconds.
stopped: The connector stopped. Start it again from the Start menu or the launcher, or it starts at your next login.

sync.title: Hub folders
sync.intro: The hub's shared project folders are kept in the sync folder. Save there as usual: the hub gets each change.
sync.held_one: {{count}} file was deleted in {{root}} at once. The hub keeps it until you choose.
sync.held_other: {{count}} files were deleted in {{root}} at once. The hub keeps them until you choose.

mode.all: This device syncs all the hub's project folders.
mode.selected: This device syncs only selected projects. Open on my workstation in the web app adds a project; Hub management removes one.

slicers.title: Slicers
slicers.intro: Open on my workstation in the web app opens files here, in the default slicer.
slicers.none: No supported slicer is installed on this device, so files can't be opened here from the web app. Install one, then restart the connector.

folders.title: Shared folders
folders.intro: The hub sees only these folders on this device: an admin can browse them and add project folders inside them. Nothing else on this device is listed.
folders.pathHint: The full path of an existing folder, for example C:\Users\me\3D or /home/me/3d

errors.notAbsolute: Enter the full path of the folder, starting at the drive or at /.
errors.notFound: There is no folder at this path.
errors.covered: This folder is shared already, as part of a shared folder.
errors.inUse: A project folder in it still has projects on the hub. Remove those projects, or the project folder, in the web app first.
errors.waiting: Waiting for the hub. Try again once the connector is online.
